title: Wellness Plan Selection by Species and Age at Enrollment
content:
A Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans enrollment is matched to a plan by the pet's species and the pet's age on the enrollment date. Each plan states the species it covers, the youngest age at which a pet may be enrolled and the oldest age at enrollment, where an oldest age of 0 means the plan has no upper age limit.

## Enrollment reference

| Plan | Species covered | Youngest age at enrollment | Oldest age at enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | dog | 6 weeks | 26 weeks |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | cat | 6 weeks | 26 weeks |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | dog | 52 weeks | 0 (no upper limit) |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | cat | 52 weeks | 0 (no upper limit) |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | dog | 364 weeks | 0 (no upper limit) |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | cat | 364 weeks | 0 (no upper limit) |

Both limits include the stated age itself: a pet whose age on the enrollment date equals the youngest or the oldest age shown is within that plan's range.

## Reading the ranges (hypothetical pets)

| Pet on the enrollment date | Plans whose species and age range it meets |
|---|---|
| Dog aged 5 weeks | none (below 6 weeks) |
| Dog aged 6 weeks | Puppy Wellness Plan |
| Cat aged 26 weeks | Kitten Wellness Plan |
| Cat aged 27 weeks | none (above 26 weeks and below 52 weeks) |
| Dog aged 52 weeks | Adult Dog Wellness Plan |
| Dog aged 363 weeks | Adult Dog Wellness Plan |
| Dog aged 364 weeks | Adult Dog Wellness Plan and Senior Dog Wellness Plan |
| Cat aged 400 weeks | Adult Cat Wellness Plan and Senior Cat Wellness Plan |

## Points of judgement

- The age that counts is the pet's age on the enrollment date, not on any later date in the term.
- A dog plan never covers a cat and a cat plan never covers a dog; the species of the plan must be the pet's species.
- From 27 weeks through 51 weeks a pet's age falls within the range of no plan of its species, because the juvenile ranges end at 26 weeks and the adult ranges begin at 52 weeks.
